Tensor glyphs are symbolic: Q blue · K green · V pink. Same glyph type ≠ shared parameters.
Masks: boolean True → −∞ before attention softmax. Decoder causal mask must be supplied by caller.
Dropout and fully-masked-row NaN guard are folded; retained in semantic_ir.json. ReLU is the source activation.
